response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind), metrics AS (SELECT analysis_count, analysis_count::numeric / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(analysis_count) OVER () AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(analysis_count) AS sum_counts, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(analysis_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM metrics WHERE analysis_count > avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: A trader type must be non-NULL and have at least one qualifying analysis to enter the average across types.

alternatives.interpretation: Include NULL trader types as one group of qualifying analyses.
alternatives.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), metrics AS (SELECT analysis_count, analysis_count::numeric / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(analysis_count) OVER () AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(analysis_count) AS sum_counts, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(analysis_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM metrics WHERE analysis_count > avg_count;

alternatives.interpretation: Include all four documented trader types in the average, including types with zero qualifying analyses.
alternatives.sql: WITH types(tradekind) AS (VALUES ('Market Maker'), ('Broker'), ('Individual'), ('Institution')), observed AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind), type_counts AS (SELECT types.tradekind, COALESCE(observed.analysis_count, 0) AS analysis_count FROM types LEFT JOIN observed ON observed.tradekind = types.tradekind), metrics AS (SELECT analysis_count, analysis_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(analysis_count) OVER (), 0) AS share, AVG(analysis_count) OVER () AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(analysis_count) AS sum_counts, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(analysis_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM metrics WHERE analysis_count > avg_count;
